full_details: At nine in the cold parlour Phillips had Nick walk the Princess's first long speech. The words of it are not set down. Sam copied the walk and reached the door before the sentence ended. You heard that your own pointing had put the breath in the wrong place, and you changed two stops on the roll and no word. Phillips said a boy has a pint of breath, and not to spend it all on the first line. At the lodging, while the carrier's name sat on the noon hour, you sewed the two groats into the paper and did not go to the Bell. At two you played in the Seven Deadly Sins. The Rose billed Knack. You did not go. After the play you walked to Carter Lane. Hobbins had left Stratford on Monday week. Twelve hours to Wycombe if the way is dry, and it is not. Oats are up a penny at Oxford. A bridge plank is gone at Shipston. The twins' day will be nine days old when the letter arrives. You wrote on the outside that the two groats are within, one to each twin. Anne's letter was a pan mended, a ladle found where your father swore he never put it, and a quarrel at the well. You asked after the cough and got mending. You paid twopence and drank one cup. At home the ledger says the letter was late. You did not send a day for Lent.
one_sentence: You moved two stops in the cold parlour, played the Sins, and gave Hobbins the Candlemas letter after.
title: Two stops, and the letter goes late
